meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你在开放技能生态里查找可安装技能:先看排行榜,再按话题搜索,依据下载量和来源可信度筛选,给出技能名与安装命令;你同意的话它还会替你安装。若没有匹配,就改用一般能力帮你,或建议自己创建技能。
howto.when: 当你说“怎么做X”“帮我找做X的技能”“你能做X吗”这类话,或表示想扩展能力、搜索工具/模板/工作流、需要某个领域帮助时,就会触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个能生成 changelog 的技能。
say.note: 会先按主题搜索,核对下载量与来源后再给安装命令。

say.text: 怎么让我做的 React 应用跑得更快?
say.note: 先查排行榜;没有匹配再搜 react 性能。

say.text: 有没有做代码审查的技能?帮我装一个。
say.note: 会搜索代码审查相关技能,核实来源后再推荐。

howto.what_en: Helps discover and install agent skills: checks skills.sh leaderboard, runs `npx skills find`, screens install counts/source, recommends, and can run the install. If no match, offers direct help or suggests creating a skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks “how do I do X”, “find a skill for X”, or “can you do X”, or mentions wanting extra capabilities, tools, templates, workflows, or help in a particular domain.

say_en.text: Find me a skill that generates changelogs.
say_en.note: Searches, verifies install counts/source, then recommends.

say_en.text: How can I make my React app faster?
say_en.note: Checks leaderboard; if no match, searches react performance.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for code review? Help me install it.
say_en.note: Searches review skills; checks the source first.
